summary.totalSpacesClaim: BART "owns and operates more than 47,000 parking spaces at 35 stations" (pricing page); "nearly 48,000 parking spaces at 35 stations" (Parking News page); 2014 MTC presentation: "47,500 spaces at 33 BART stations".
summary.bartGIS_sumNote: Sum of BART GIS ParkingSpaces over stations with BART-operated parking as classified here (Lake Merritt set to 0, Pittsburg Center GIS=0, excludes VTA-run Berryessa/Milpitas). This 49,196 is somewhat above the 47-48k headline (GIS values are from 2025-05 edits and may include spaces since removed, e.g. Fremont/El Cerrito Plaza/Lafayette/West Oakland reductions, or non-BART spaces such as the private Walnut Creek South Garage).
summary.hours: Payment required Monday-Friday 4am-3pm; free after 3pm, weekends and BART holidays (overview page).
summary.dailyVsReservedSplitNote: No current per-station count of Daily Fee vs Reserved (permit) spaces was found on BART pages, GIS, or FAQs. Historical (VTA SVRTC EIS ch.5, ~2003): BART designated "Up to 25 percent of the spaces at each station ... (up to 40 percent at San Mateo County stations)" as monthly reserved - not stored as a number here because it is ~20 years old; raw file vta_bart_core_parking_ch5.pdf.
summary.pricingPolicy: 2023 policy: Daily Fee floor $3/ceiling $6.30, Single/Multi $4/$11, Monthly $84/$220 (2023 dollars, excl. local taxes; no ceiling at West Oakland). Rates may rise up to 30% at most every 6 months if occupancy or sales >90%, may fall if <70%. From 2025 floor/ceiling may be indexed with fares, not to exceed $8/day, $11/day, $220/month.

occupancy.stationPageFillTimes: Per-station "Estimated Parking Fill Time" in stations[].fillTime_stationPage (fetched 2026-10-04). Nearly all say "capacity available at all times"; MacArthur "Parking at capacity by 10:30am"; Glen Park and West Oakland "Limited parking at this station. Fill times vary by day."

spring2026Above90pct.what: Daily Fee areas where Spring 2026 parking counts showed occupancy exceeding 90 percent (triggering daily-fee increases July 1, 2026); reserved single/multi-day >90% at Rockridge, San Bruno, Walnut Creek; reserved sales low at Castro Valley and Union City.

january2026HighDemand.what: "high-demand stations" given the 30% daily-fee increase on Jan 1, 2026; reserved prices raised at Millbrae, San Bruno, Walnut Creek and lowered at nine lower-demand stations (Colma, Concord, El Cerrito del Norte, Dublin/Pleasanton, Fremont, Pittsburg/Bay Point, Pleasant Hill/Contra Costa Centre, South San Francisco, West Dublin/Pleasanton).

weekdayOccupancyShare_selectedStations.units: share of parking spots taken on a typical weekday (point-in-time count); 2019 counted in fall, 2022-2026 in spring
weekdayOccupancyShare_selectedStations.method: Datawrapper dataset.csv for chart vGGou versions 3 (Coliseum, Walnut Creek, West Dublin/Pleasanton) and 1 (adds Pleasant Hill/Contra Costa Centre); chart credits source "BART".

systemwideNarrative.value: Pittsburg Center 99% and Warm Springs 98% full in fall 2019, "around 10% occupancy since the spring of 2024"; "Parking areas at other stations are on average about half full, as indicated by manual counts the agency conducts twice a year"; Coliseum "about 16% full".

preCovid2014.value: "Several lots fill up by 7am"; "All spaces fill Monday through Thursday, except 150 spaces at Millbrae"; 38,000 people on monthly permit waitlists.

herculesParkAndRide.text: BART jointly operates the Hercules Park & Ride lot with the City of Hercules and WestCAT. Only reserved parking is available. Single/multi-day reserved $3/day, monthly reserved $63/month.

stations.name: Berryessa/North San Jose
stations.parkingDescription_stationPage: Parking at Berryessa/North San Jose Station is managed by VTA and offers: 1,527 parking spaces $3 daily fee Monthly parking passes are available for $50 Advanced payment for long-term parking can be made on the website or at on-site pay stations at the rate of $7 per calendar day. There is no limit on the number of days you can park long-term. There are 24 Electric Vehicle (EV) charging stations Parking can be paid for via the Passport parking app, at pay machines, and on VTA’s website at https://www.vta.org/projects/bart-sv/phase-i/parking Remember your license plate number as you will need it to pay for parking. Pay stations will accept all major credit cards and $1 and $5 bills. As no change will be provided from the pay stations, a change machine is in each parking garage to break larger bills into smaller bills. Parking will be first come, first serve. No reservations are offered Note: parking at this station is managed by VTA and is not part of BART’s parking program. For full details about parking at this station visit: https://www.vta.org/projects/bart-sv/phase-i/parking

acTransbay.period_note: AC Transit fiscal year = July-June (FY2025 = Jul 2024-Jun 2025). Values are "Average Daily Ridership" from the Weekday table of each year's Route Performance attachment (Board Policy 545 annual report).
acTransbay.method: Text extracted from the PDFs with pypdf. Each weekday row reads: route, type, peak freq, off-peak freq, minority flag, [current-FY revenue trips, revenue hours], [PRIOR-FY average daily ridership + 5 effectiveness measures], [CURRENT-FY average daily ridership + 5 measures], 6 % changes. Column order was verified with the printed % change (e.g. FY25 F: 2,075 -> 2,226 = +7.2%, matches) and with productivity (FY25 F: 2,226 x ~252 weekdays / 23,644 revenue hours = 23.7 pax/rev-hr, matches the printed FY24/25 productivity). FY2024 values from the FY25 report equal the FY24 report's own FY23/24 values for every line (checked). Fall 2024/2025 = average of Sep, Oct, Nov average daily weekday ridership (Realign comparison; first block = 2024, second = 2025, confirmed by discontinued LA/OX having only the first block and by the staff report table).
